name: xmuse_whoami
description: Who you are in xmuse: id, role, peers, your threads.

name: xmuse_send
description: Send a message. to = peer id (DM), 'human', or a group thread like '#task'. In a group, list the peers who must act in `mentions`; only they (and the thread owner) are woken.

kind.description: default message; decision/assumption/question also record a shared entry

scope.description: entry scope: global (or all) | role:<role> | module:<name> (only agents working on that module see it) | thread (default); kind=handoff: module:<name>[,<name>...] = the modules the assignee owns

on_behalf_of.description: Coordinator (desktop) sessions only. Use only when the user explicitly asked for this message to go out in their name; quote their words. Default is to send as yourself.

name: xmuse_ack
description: Mark messages handled, optionally with an outcome (e.g. review verdict).

name: xmuse_thread
description: Read a thread's recent messages, or search it with `query`.

name: xmuse_context
description: Your alignment view: active decisions, assumptions, open questions, work assigned to you.

name: xmuse_done
description: End your turn with the exit check: summary and who moves next.

next.description: peer id or 'human' who must act next, or 'none' if the work is finished

declares.description: decisions/assumptions/questions others will depend on; one decision per cross-module convention (representation, units, errors, ordering, output format)

scope.description: global (or all) | role:<role> | module:<name> (only agents working on that module see it) | thread (default); kind=handoff: module:<name>[,<name>...] = the modules the assignee owns

name: xmuse_approve
description: Coordinator (desktop) sessions only: relay the user's decision on a held command (the hub's 'asks permission' notice). Only after the user said so in this conversation; quote their words in user_said.

id.description: approval id from the notice, e.g. per_9
